en: Vintage sepia-toned group photograph of dozens of schoolgirls and two adults posed outdoors in front of dense foliage. The girls wear sailor-style blouses with dark collars and large bows, and long skirts, while a seated man in a dark suit and a standing woman in a dark dress appear at the center beside a small table with a floral arrangement. The reverse side bears a purple studio stamp from "Atelier Diujanski 'Foto Arta' Blaj" and handwritten Romanian text noting the class, names, year 1924, and a note about a reunion in 1934.
